reviews.text: They are very affectionate and responsible with my pets. They are attentive. And sometimes they have even shown me that I had a little problem that needed treatment. I think my dogs like them more than me, lol 🐕🐕 They give affection, take them for walks. 💐 I recommend them. …
They are excellent professionals and take very good care of the dogs. I recommend them!
They're great! They take walks, look after my dog ​​with all the love in the world, and even teach her some commands that help us in our daily lives. Teresa loves her uncles and aunts ❤️
Hionara and Guto are wonderful! Super attentive and caring with our doggies!! I highly recommend them!!

Hionara and Guto are very attentive, professional, caring, and kind pet sitters!!!! They send photos, videos, and information during the stay to reassure us and lessen the longing caused by the distance!!!! Snoopy's stay is guaranteed with them!!!! I highly recommend them!!!! 🙏🏻🐶❤️ …
Excellent! Super attentive, responsible, and careful! 🥰🥰 …

I was recommended by another dog walker to meet Hionara and Guto because my brother also needed people to walk his dogs on weekends. They are super kind, trustworthy, and caring, and I recommend them without hesitation! Our dog is a working dog, so he's more wary because he was trained abroad and doesn't understand Portuguese. What I can say is that after three walks, he's already waiting at the door for them to arrive!! I can only thank them from the bottom of my heart because, in addition to everything else, they make sure the dog interacts with other canine friends, which is very important for him! Very happy and satisfied with the service!!

I trust Hionara and Guto completely when I leave my little dog with them. They are incredible with animals, take great care of them, and spoil them all. I travel a lot for work, and when I need to leave my dog ​​with them, I do so with peace of mind, without feeling heartbroken. I just miss her, but I have no worries. I highly recommend them.

We loved Chico's stay at Patas da Orla! Hionara and Guto were attentive and caring with our puppy!

We highly recommend them, and now we have their go-to place for when we need them!
Hionara is amazing, always very attentive and helpful. Our puppies love her; every time we travel and can't take them with us, we ask Hionara to help us.
Guto is super responsible and loving with the dogs! I trust him completely and my dogs love the walks. I highly recommend him! 🐾 …
Excellent! Dexter loves Hionara and Guto!

Hionara is amazing!
My Maya is so happy walking with her and being very well taken care of when I need it!

Plus, she even gives attention to my kitten when he comes to my house 🥰🥰
Hionara and Guto are fantastic with dogs...caring, always punctual, very reliable! I highly recommend them!
Hionara and Guto are wonderful and extremely trustworthy! I trust them and highly recommend them ❤️
Excellent professional... or rather, a true friend, because he takes such good care of our most precious treasure... my four-legged daughter.
They take very good care of our pet. We feel at ease when they walk or board Bob.
Caring and affectionate, I recommend them 100%!!!
Hionara and Guto are two people who truly love animals and care for your pet as if it were their own. I trust them 100% with my two schnauzers and have always had a great experience!
Excellent professionals! Tukinha loves walk time!!
My Tukinha loves Uncle Guto! Guto and Hionara are caring, attentive, and committed professionals to our pets! They provide walks with lots of love and safety! Thank you 💛🐾🐾🩷 …
The best of Copacabana.
Hionara and Guto are a 1000 out of 10! I wholeheartedly recommend their work and dedication to Filó, Tobi, and Lucca!
Hionara and Guto are simply incredible! Besides being excellent professionals, they are wonderful people. Our little one is in love with them! ❤️
They are wonderful!!! Super professional, careful and very loving with our pets.
They've been taking care of my little one since he was a puppy!!! When they're with him, they turn their backs and walk away, they don't even look back! I recommend them without hesitation!

My Brownie has been with Hionara and Guto for over 6 years! He simply LOVES them! I always travel with peace of mind knowing that he will be well cared for, respected, and will receive lots of love and affection! Thank you always!
Think of a job of excellence and professionalism! Thank you so much for your kindness and for the beautiful work.

Hionara is not only a great professional but also a wonderful person. She walked my dogs Toró and Amora for over five years, and only stopped because I moved to another city. Trustworthy and always helpful, I recommend her to anyone looking for a dog walker.
